description: This line plot compares the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) of four different model architectures as a function of the activated parameters ratio, expressed as a percentage. The x-axis, labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)”, is linearly scaled from 100% down to 25%, with tick marks appearing at every 25% interval. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL”, is linearly scaled from approximately 11.5 to 14.0. The four model configurations are represented by distinct lines: the “Transformer” is shown as a dashed red line with circular markers, remaining constant at a value of 11.8 throughout the range; the “Only MoHD FFN” is a gray line with square markers, starting at 11.7 and declining to 11.5; the “Only MoHD ATTN” is a dark blue line with circular markers, starting at 11.7 and increasing to 14.0; and the “MoHD ATTN + MLP” is a blue line with cross markers, starting at 11.7 and increasing to 13.1.
